layoutDescription:
The layout of this map is somewhat maze-like reminiscent of [The Belly of the Beast](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Belly_of_the_Beast) layouts, but with the tileset of [Primordial Pool Map](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Primordial_Pool_Map)Primordial Pool MapMap Level: 77
Map Tier: 10
Guild Character: ÂTravel to this Map by using it in a personal Map Device. Maps can only be used once..

The boss arena is typically located along the upper edge of the map. The arena itself is triangular, with each corner containing a corpse flower holding one of the members of [The Godless Three](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Godless_Three) that remain dormant until entering the center of the arena.
bossDescription:
[Nightmare of the Depraved Trinity](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Nightmare_of_the_Depraved_Trinity) - This boss is an uber version of [The Depraved Trinity](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Depraved_Trinity).

Phase 1: The player must fight the Godless Three (based on their regular map versions) simultaneously. When killed, their invulnerable apparitions (based on their [The Rotting Core](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Rotting_Core) versions) will continue to attack and create arena hazards. They disappear after all three bosses have been defeated.

Phase 2: Nightmare of the Depraved Trinity (based on [Amalgam of Nightmares](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Amalgam_of_Nightmares))

boss.description: The map is filled with skeletons that will not lie down. The Restless Dead map mod means that monsters come back to life 10 seconds after being killed unless their corpse is removed (via shatter or corpse explosion for example). The resurrected skeletons don’t provide and experience or drop any loot. Bosses can resurrect any monster, even each other. This means the fight can go on unless you kill both bosses at approximately the same time or theo stopped reviving the other.

bossDescription:
• [Avatar of the Forge](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Avatar_of_the_Forge)

• [Avatar of the Skies](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Avatar_of_the_Skies)

• [Avatar of the Huntress](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Avatar_of_the_Huntress)

The bosses are based on the mini-bosses in [The Grand Arena](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Grand_Arena) of [Act 4](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Act_4): [Dimachaeri Cassius](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Dimachaeri_Cassius), [Mevion](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Mevion) and [Rudiarius Felix](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Rudiarius_Felix)

This map has 3 bosses with 3 phases. When one of them reaches a health threshold (or dies) other bosses in range change their behaviour as if they reached the next threshold.

[Avatar of the Huntress](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Avatar_of_the_Huntress), based on [Rudiarius Felix](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Rudiarius_Felix).

• Throws [Caustic Arrow](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Caustic_Arrow) traps in all phases.

• Throws [Puncture](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Puncture) traps in all phases.

• From 75% to 50% health casts [Vulnerability](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Vulnerability).

• From 50% health uses [Barrage](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Barrage).

[Avatar of the Skies](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Avatar_of_the_Skies), based on [Mevion](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Mevion).

• From 100% to 75% health casts [Flammability](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Flammability) and [Summon Raging Spirit](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Summon_Raging_Spirit).

• From 75% to 50% health casts [Flameblast](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Flameblast).

• At 50% health casts [Vaal Summon Skeletons](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Vaal_Summon_Skeletons).

• From 50% health uses [Vaal Haste](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Vaal_Haste) and a projectile fire attack with 3 projectiles.

[Avatar of the Forge](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Avatar_of_the_Forge), based on [Dimachaeri Cassius](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Dimachaeri_Cassius).

• Grants endurance charges to allies.

• Fire damage.

• From 100% to 75% health uses [Cyclone](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Cyclone).

• From 75% to 50% health uses [Glacial Hammer](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Glacial_Hammer) and [Vaal Glacial Hammer](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Vaal_Glacial_Hammer).

• From 50% health uses [Frenzy](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Frenzy), [Leap Slam](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Leap_Slam), [Double Strike](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Double_Strike) and a slam with reverse knockback.

cards.cardLore: A tower built of the strongest stone is not eternal; a towering intellect is not enlightened.

cards.name: The Wrath
cards.cardLore: "Daughter of catastrophe, mother of pain. Amongst the filth of Wraeclast, she wanders, and her wrath follows." - Quintoon the Returned

boss.description: Same as Arid Lake boss except reskinned. Again, breaking nests heals/enrages boss making it significantly more difficult.

bossDescription: [Skullbeak](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Skullbeak), a [bone rhoa](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Bone_Rhoa)

boss.description: Resummons nearby minions. Casts Spirit Offering and Vaal Summon Skeletons. Focus on killing the boss over the unique skeletons as these can be revived by the boss.

bossDescription: • [Xixic, High Necromancer](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Xixic,_High_Necromancer), based on [Sawbones](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Sawbones)

cards.name: Rain of Chaos
cards.cardLore: Fire filled the sky that nightChaos reignedWhere the shards fellAll was destroyed-Jozen Kasigi, retelling an urban legend of the Cataclysm

cards.name: The Spark and the Flame
cards.cardLore: When sky meets ground the flames can be found, but who has the will to tame them.

cards.name: Underground Forest
cards.cardLore: "In the forest again... But at least I have these."

cards.name: The Transformation
cards.cardLore: Even the most beautiful of transformations can still have a dark side.

bossDescription:
The map contains a trio of bosses: [Melur Thornmaul](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Melur_Thornmaul), [Orvi Acidbeak](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Orvi_Acidbeak) and [Elida Blisterclaw](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Elida_Blisterclaw).

These bosses cannot be duplicated by the map mod Area contains two Unique Bosses.

cards.name: The Bitter Blossom
cards.cardLore: The pain you feel is of no consequence, it is evolution, to be made whole within something greater.

cards.name: The Demoness
cards.cardLore: Wherever she went, death was sure to follow.

cards.name: The Explorer
cards.cardLore: A map is only useful if you know where you stand.

cards.name: Astral Protection
cards.cardLore: For a time, we had something stronger than eldritch evil.We had each other.

boss.description: Continually spawns zombies. Has Soul Eater, increasing damage/health/speed whenever a nearby enemy is slain. Casts Desecrate and Detonate Dead. Do not stand on corpse of boss in double boss map

cards.name: Brother's Stash
cards.cardLore: Even though he found the stash just in time,He would trade it all away and then some to have him back.

cards.name: The Betrayal
cards.cardLore: It's sad times we live in when a friendship has a price people are willing to pay.

cards.name: The Doctor
cards.cardLore: "They said I needed my head examined, but I'd rather just take yours." - Klopek the Cannibal

cards.name: The Union
cards.cardLore: On the 21st of Eterni,two become one,their light outshinesthe setting sun.

boss.description:
The map contains two types of mobs. Firstly, wolves which Puncture inflicting a severe Bleed. Ensure you bring along a Bleed removal flask. Secondly, wolf cultists which deal use Caustic Arrow and Viper Strike to inflict chaos damage – these guys aren’t too frightening. Walking through this linear Den you will encounter two unique wolves which deal substantial elemental damage. Winterbite has a powerful Ice Nova and creates Frost Bombs on the ground. Storm Eye casts a Lightning Storm as well as using a strong Lightning Strike attack. Both of them can also Leap Slam. 
At the end of the Den is a Cave which contains Winterbite, Storm Eye and Solus, the most powerful wolf of the three. Solus deals exclusively in Fire spells, dishing out very fast Flameblasts and multiple projectile Magma Orbs. Because the cave is small there isn’t really anywhere to hide. My recommendation is to keep moving, you may eventually be able to kite one of the wolves away from the others.
Physical Lacerate attack. Channels swarm of bats.

layoutDescription: Map is a long and winding corridor with a few dead ended branches along its length. Roughly midway along its length, the coils of the map's corridors come into contact, though you cannot cross this gap. The boss arena lies at the end of the map corridor.
bossDescription:
[Executioner Bloodwing](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Executioner_Bloodwing) (based on [Justicar Casticus](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Justicar_Casticus))

• [Lacerate](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Lacerate)

• [Spectral Shield Throw](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Spectral_Shield_Throw)

• Channels, summoning several Blood Ravens over duration

boss.description: Fire Leap Slam that always ignites. Powerful Physical/Fire slam that may one shot. Summons Archers and Raging Spirits when damaged. Not too much health.

bossDescription:
• [The Infernal King](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Infernal_King), based on [Kaom](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Kaom)

The map has two side bosses which must be killed to open the entrance to the last 1/3 of the map area and the boss room:

• [The Vindicated Queen](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Vindicated_Queen), based on [The Dishonoured Queen](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Dishonoured_Queen)

• [The Revered Advisor](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Revered_Advisor/edit?redlink=1)

boss.description: Both bosses are deadly. When one dies the other enrages gaining damage and health. Pitbull inflicts a deadly Bleed. Chicken fires Poison Arrow and Vaal Rain of Arrows which can prevent you from moving. Recommend kill the Chicken first then kite the Pitbull.

bossDescription:
This [Map](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Map) has two bosses.

[Stonebeak, Battle Fowl](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Stonebeak,_Battle_Fowl), based on [Eyepecker](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Eyepecker). Uses [Split Arrow](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Split_Arrow), [Caustic Arrow](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Caustic_Arrow) and [Vaal Rain of Arrows](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Vaal_Rain_of_Arrows).

[Gnar, Eater of Carrion](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Gnar,_Eater_of_Carrion), based on [Steelchaw](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Steelchaw). Uses the monster version [Vengeance](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Counterattack) and a powerful charge that causes [bleeding](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Bleed).

After either one dies, the remaining one becomes enraged.

cards.name: The Arena Champion
cards.cardLore: The fight is the easy part. It's the years of training that'll kill you.

cards.name: The Deceiver
cards.cardLore: Beware the combatant who shows no confidence, yet still enters the ring, for they are surely hiding something.

cards.name: The King's Blade
cards.cardLore: "To know for what you fight. To get up again when you've been struck down. To outmanoeuvre someone faster, trick someone smarter, crush someone stronger. That's what it takes to claim the crown."- Daresso, the King of Swords

cards.name: I See Brothers
cards.cardLore: "Where does the light gowhen it is dark?"

boss.description: Keep out of way of the giant Ball Lightning which will hang about the edge of the arena. At 75/50/25% health the Trinity runs off leaving 6 Scorpions that deal a high amount of physical damage if you let them all attack you at once.

layoutDescription: The Tileset is based [The Rotting Core](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Rotting_Core) in Act 9. However, this version does not have any side bosses. The Layout is a linear path with two branches that connect in a circle, with a path in the middle splitting the map, with a few offshoots.
bossDescription: The boss is the [Amalgam of Nightmares](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Amalgam_of_Nightmares), based on the Act 9 boss [The Depraved Trinity](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Depraved_Trinity).

boss.description: Strong physical attacks. Gains Frenzy charges with Frenzy. Flicker Strikes. Throws Smoke Mines that deal Physical and Fire damage. After 75% health uses a very powerful Blade Flurry attack, keep out.

bossDescription: [Leif, the Swift-Handed](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Leif,_the_Swift-Handed), based on the unique bandit, [Kraityn](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Kraityn).

cards.name: The Easy Stroll
cards.cardLore: "I'm going for a walk. I'll be back soon."- Blonca's last words

cards.name: The Enlightened
cards.cardLore: Weaving the six,a serpent stands tall.Wearing a crown,the thousand petals call.

cards.name: The Fox
cards.cardLore: "Masters of wit, strength and cunning. To survive the harsh winters, you must be like the fox."- Ezomyte Proverb

cards.name: The Tyrant
cards.cardLore: "Fear controls the masses."- Laszlo, the Scourge

boss.description: Avoid large Ball Lightning and spray of small Lightning projectiles. Boss will lay a small circle on the ground then ghost Brutus will appear slamming the area for massive Physical/Lightning damage. Boss also summons small lightning orb minions and books which explode after a time.

bossDescription: [Shavronne the Sickening](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Shavronne_the_Sickening), based on [Shavronne, Unbound](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Shavronne,_Unbound).

cards.name: Harmony of Souls
cards.cardLore: Shrieking souls locked awayHate splits frozen cells asunderThe knot of corruptionundone at last

cards.name: The Nurse
cards.cardLore: We tried to tell him to get his head checked.

cards.name: The Warden
cards.cardLore: Brutus' first innovation as Lord Incarcerator was a weighted chain around every neck so that his prisoners would forever bow to him.

cards.name: The Dungeon Master
cards.cardLore: "So desperate was I for control, I turned my entire world into a prison. Now you will share in my agony."

boss.description: Deals strong Physical melee attacks. Avoid telegraphed slam and dark patches of ground that deal DoT. Boss will channel for several seconds summoning short lived Physical projectiles from all directions.  As boss loses life player gains stack of Despair debuff (unremovable) which slows you, reduces your light radius and increases damage taken. Therefore the boss becomes much more deadly as the fight progresses, pays to try to save burst damage/flasks for towards the end of the fight.

layoutDescription: The map consists of a large walled in continuous area with a few impassable pits and other obstacles. The boss is found in a separate arena.
bossDescription: [Erebix, Light's Bane](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Erebix,_Light%27s_Bane) based on [Gruthkul, Mother of Despair](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Gruthkul,_Mother_of_Despair).

cards.name: Cursed Words
cards.cardLore: If you look hard enough for hidden meaning, you will find it.

cards.name: The Bear Woman
cards.cardLore: For the blessed bear in the cave,A hundred days pass in silence and darkness,until moon begins its fourth passage,the bear sheds her beastly fur,and is reborn, human and whole.

cards.name: The Cacophony
cards.cardLore: Nothing can be heard above the din or seen amongst the turmoil. The senses are shattered. All is left to fate.

cards.name: Man With Bear
cards.cardLore: A stereotypical joke may lead to an unexpected bond.

layoutDescription:
The layout of this map is an indoor layout of several interconnected corridors. The boss arena is small with gilded railings, reminiscent of one of the arenas for [The Purifier](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Purifier).

An Originator's Aberration environmental lore object can be found outside the arena.
bossDescription:
[The Cardinal of Fear](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Cardinal_of_Fear) - this boss is based on [Cardinal Sanctus Vox](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Cardinal_Sanctus_Vox).

Skills:

• Default Mace Swing

• Mace Combo - Swings twice, creating novas of projectiles, then dashes forward with a third attack.

• Shatter Shield Beam - Fires a projection of his shield forward before firing a wide beam of energy. The beam splits into a 180 degree cone of fireball projectiles when it hits the shield that apply Scorch. Summons 4 Guardians of Eternity around him that activate when the player approaches.

• Charged Net - Fires a mortar on the ground that explodes after a duration, inflicting Scorch.

• Mass Beam - Rapidly marks several expanding circular areas on the ground before firing beams at the markers. Immediately follows up with a wide beam of energy.

cards.name: The Fiend
cards.cardLore: Your era is now,your power unwavered,soon we will seewho the gods truly favoured.

cards.name: The Polymath
cards.cardLore: Genius knows no limits.

cards.name: The Forgotten Treasure
cards.cardLore: Don't let fool's gold deceive you.

cards.name: Justified Ambition
cards.cardLore: "Everything I have done has been for Wraeclast. You would pledge your life to me if you saw things my way... and soon, you will."- High Templar Venarius

boss.description: Powerful telegraphed Cleave with larger radius. Summons a pack of Infested Vulture.

bossDescription: [The Winged Death](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Winged_Death), based on [The Hundred Foot Shadow](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Hundred_Foot_Shadow)

cards.name: The Scavenger
cards.cardLore: Take small pieces of things and then assemble them together

cards.name: The Side Quest
cards.cardLore: You'll never know the things you miss if you keep your eyes closed

cards.name: Desperate Crusade
cards.cardLore: Through despondent hardships, those strong of spirit shall claim the prize.

boss.description: Strong Physical attacks. Sunder. Doesn't feel as strong as Uber Labyrinth Argus, also isn't immune to status ailments. Enrages for 8 seconds (turns red) increasing damage, movement speed and attack speed by 100%. Decoy Totem comes in handy for casters and ranged characters.

layoutDescription: Tileset based on [the Lord's Labyrinth](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Lord%27s_Labyrinth). The map begins with a large courtyard, and an interior section to the south leads to the boss arena.
bossDescription: • [Hephaeus, The Hammer](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Hephaeus,_The_Hammer), based on [Argus](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Argus)

cards.name: Boon of Justice
cards.cardLore: Some gifts are obligations while others are simply opportunities.

cards.name: Brotherhood in Exile
cards.cardLore: Seeking shelter from the night,in the warmth of the run-down inn,erstwhile foes put aside the fight,to bond over whiskey and gin.

cards.name: The Trial
cards.cardLore: You cannot journey to new lands until you have the courage to leave the safety of home.

cards.name: Man With Bear
cards.cardLore: A stereotypical joke may lead to an unexpected bond.

layoutDescription:
This map's layout consists of a large maze of corridors with several dead ends. Many parts of this area contains small gaps that can be crossed with a movement skill. This map uses a greyscale Expedition tileset used in some underground areas.

The boss arena is identical to that of the [Uhtred](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Uhtred) encounter.
bossDescription:
Nightmare of Uhtred - This boss is an uber version of [Uhtred, Covetous Traitor](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Uhtred,_Covetous_Traitor). At 66% and 33% life, the boss will disappear into the mirror and summon minibosses based on [Vorana, Last to Fall](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Vorana,_Last_to_Fall) (Nightmare of Vorana), and [Medved, Feller of Heroes](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Medved,_Feller_of_Heroes) (Nightmare of Medved), respectively.

The arena is a wide rectangular shape with a large mirror along the northeastern wall. Nightmare of Uhtred shatters the mirror to hide inside and spawns adds from it during intermission phases. Wide groups of lasers will also fire in random parallel directions from the mirror after the first intermission phase until the end of the fight, increasing in width the lower Nightmare of Uhtred's health becomes. The lasers charge and fire faster than the regular Uhtred encounter.

cards.name: A Sea of Blue
cards.cardLore: The harvest ended, the floods began.

cards.name: Grave Knowledge
cards.cardLore: The dead tell me great insights. They've had nothing but time to sit and think.

cards.name: The Celestial Justicar
cards.cardLore: Wrapped in the glory of the heavens, she comes to mete out justice for the fallen.

cards.name: The Forsaken
cards.cardLore: You gave us life and love, more than you could spare. Now you're gone, and we are stranded, alone, cold and without purpose.

cards.name: The Jeweller's Boon
cards.cardLore: The jeweller's true talent is the capacity to see a jewel's beauty before they draw it out.

cards.name: The Void
cards.cardLore: Reach into the Void and claim your prize.

cards.name: Wealth and Power
cards.cardLore: The greatness of a man is not in how much wealth or power he acquires, but in his integrity and his ability to positively affect those around him.

cards.name: The Rabbit's Foot
cards.cardLore: It is said anyone who bears this trinket is the luckiest exile in all of Wraeclast. The gods would disagree, and forever curse any whom give it away.

cards.name: The Shieldbearer
cards.cardLore: While you grow, I shall be your knight, and you my squire. One day, you shall be the one who stands and defends our home.

boss.description: The two Matriarchs throw Magma Orbs which inflict heavy Ignites. Carius has a powerful Chaos degen which follows the character. After one of the bosses die the others enrage gaining damage and health. Recommend killing Carius first.

layoutDescription: Rectangular city map with building blocks dividing it. Bosses always found in the middle central square.
bossDescription:
• Pileah, Corpse Burner - based on [The Matriarch](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Matriarch)

• Pileah, Burning Corpse - based on [The Rotten Matriarch](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Rotten_Matriarch)

• Carius, the Unnatural - Unique [Twisted Effigy](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Twisted_Effigy/edit?redlink=1)

When one boss is defeated, the remaining bosses will [enrage](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Enrage).

cards.name: A Modest Request
cards.cardLore: Cede all power and wealth to me and serve me in perpetuity.A minor inconvenience I assure you.

cards.name: The Sigil
cards.cardLore: Three men travelthrough the gate;they carry a protective ward.A faction conspiresagainst their fate,but magic unravels the sword.

cards.name: Three Voices
cards.cardLore: The village elders had a curious rule: If you hear three voices scream for aid, flee as fast as you can.

cards.name: Home
cards.cardLore: There are countless people, countless stories, and countless eras, but there is one place that, for a time, each of us loved and was loved. It matters. We matter.

layoutDescription: Outdoor snowy environment. There is a river which is frozen over so that characters and monster can walk across.

boss.description: Much stronger than Armoury Gravicius. His Firestorm, Fire trap and Molten Shell abilities hit hard so ensure you have adequate fire mitigation. Gravicius has a large ES pool (cannot be bypassed by Chaos damage). At 2/3 and 1/3 life Gravicius will return to his tent regaining all his ES back. This fight can be long so you may need to portal to get back flask charges.

bossDescription: [Tyrant](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Tyrant_(unique_monster)), based on [General Gravicius](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/General_Gravicius) of [Act 3](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Act_3).

boss.description: Quick Physical/Cold attacks. Kneels to heal at 25%/50%/75% health. After healing gains 75% increased attack speed for 6 seconds. AoE Reave has Resolute Technique. Always be wary of spinning blades that contiually spawn, they deal serious Physical DoT. Decoy Totem work wonders in this fight.

layoutDescription:
Indoors and Outdoors. Based on [Daresso's Dream](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Daresso%27s_Dream) and [The Grand Arena](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Grand_Arena).

The current version of this map has a bluish color filter added on it, so that the rendered image are different from Daresso's Dream/The Grand Arena, but without adding new texture file. In some corner of the map, the bluish color filter can be disabled as a bug, showing the original color of Daresso's Dream/The Grand Arena tileset.
bossDescription: • [Ambrius, Legion Slayer](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Ambrius,_Legion_Slayer), based on [Daresso, King of Swords](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Daresso,_King_of_Swords) of [Act 4](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Act_4)

cards.name: The Last One Standing
cards.cardLore: The strongest emerge from suffering. The toughest bear the most scars. The sole survivor claims the greatest of rewards.

cards.name: The Mad King
cards.cardLore: Fear the man who lusts for power, for he will do anything to get it.

cards.name: The Sword King's Salute
cards.cardLore: Many were slain by the sword kingTheir blood decorating his ringThose who retreated were slaughteredThose who fought bravely were honoured

cards.name: The Watcher
cards.cardLore: Strange eyes on top of spinesGaze beyond the veil of timeDeep down below the minesA dream of crimson and of grime

boss.description: Shield Charges, leaving behind weak Physical projectiles.

bossDescription: [The Forgotten Soldier](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Forgotten_Soldier), based on [Hector Titucius, Eternal Servant](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Hector_Titucius,_Eternal_Servant)

boss.description: Try not to engage all bosses at once. Arsonists cast Fireballs, Decimator casts Glacial Cascade and Demolishers have melee Physical attacks. Save the captain till last as he heals while his friends are still alive. The captain uses Taunt and has a modest Physical melee attack.

bossDescription: • [Captain Tanner Lightfoot](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Captain_Tanner_Lightfoot) and other mini bosses. They are based on the [Gemling Legionnaire](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Gemling_Legionnaire) in [The Grain Gate](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Grain_Gate).

boss.description: The Depraved Trio of Maligaro, Shavronne and Doedre all maintain serious damage but have little health and should make for short work. Phase 1 Malachai avoid the "Die and be reborn" one-shot slam. In phase 2 avoid the teleport slam. The main difficulty of this boss comes from the small arena and ease to make a fatal mistake in a long fight. Absolutely manic with some map mods such as extra projectiles or double boss.

layoutDescription: Core Map uses the [Belly tileset](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Belly_tileset). Based on [The Harvest](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Harvest_(area)) in [Act 4](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Act_4).
bossDescription:
• [Prodigy of Pain](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Prodigy_of_Pain)

• [Prodigy of Hexes](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Prodigy_of_Hexes)

• [Prodigy of Darkness](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Prodigy_of_Darkness)

• [Eater of Souls](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Eater_of_Souls)

The Depraved Trio of Maligaro, Shavronne and Doedre (the Prodigy trio of this map) all maintain serious damage but have little health and should make for short work. Phase 1 Malachai avoid the "Die and be reborn" one-shot slam. In phase 2 avoid the teleport slam. The main difficulty of this boss comes from the small arena and ease to make a fatal mistake in a long fight. Absolutely manic with some map mods such as extra projectiles or double boss.

cards.name: The Aesthete
cards.cardLore: "Some see our mortal flesh as a limitation. I see it as an opportunity for vast, miraculous improvements."- Shavronne of Umbra

cards.name: The Offering
cards.cardLore: Eternal beauty has a cost, one which Shavronne was happy to pay with the lives of others.

cards.name: The Prince of Darkness
cards.cardLore: Fear a man who is willing to sacrifice anything for power.

cards.name: Parasitic Passengers
cards.cardLore: Feeding on death, they grew stronger and stronger, until they were ready to hatch...

boss.description: Use Physical/Chaos attacks. Watch out for Vulnerability curse and Bleeding. Can deal alot of damage between them very quickly. Bosses do not have too much health.

layoutDescription:
The map is based on [The Templar Courts](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Templar_Courts) and [Oriath Square](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Oriath_Square) tilesets.

It is a large area of interconnected courthouse rooms alternating with courtyards of various sizes. The map bosses are waiting in a separate arena.

boss.description: At the start of the map run along the walkways past all the orange portals. At the last platform running over portal will spawn the boss, the Avatar. In his first three forms the Avatar will use a range of powerful elemental spells of a single element. After killing each form the Avatar will become immune to all damage and start chasing the player. At this point you must kite the Avatar back the way you came to the orange portal on the next platform. Along the way animated weapons will spawn which can be used to regain flask charges. The Avatar has massive AoE, so watch out for the Flameblasts, Ice Nova (almost the whole screen) and Storm Calls. On the last platform, the Avatar will go from using a single element to using all three concurrently, effectively making the fight thrice as difficult. Pop all your flasks and kill him fast or he will kill you. Retreat behind the pillars if you need to recuperate but beware of his Ice Nova which has massive range.

bossDescription: The boss is [Woad, Mockery of Man](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Monster:Metadata/Monsters/AvariusCasticus/AvariusCasticusWickermanMap) based on the boss [Avarius, Reassembled](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Avarius,_Reassembled) in Act 10. The debuff from the red beams he summons is [Heretical Flare](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Heretical_Flare), a physical [damage over time](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Damage_over_time) effect. Armour does not protect against it but direct "Physical Damage Reduction" and "Reduced damage over time" (e.g. from [pantheon](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Pantheon)) counter it[[1]](#cite_note-1). It is probably countered more easily by moving out of its way as it has only two simple patterns.

boss.description:
Probably the most unique out of all the unique maps. GGG has immortalized players who had purchased a Grandmaster supporter pack in the game by allowing them to add a character of theirs (mirrored gear and all) into this map. You fight about 30 waves of 5 grandmasters at a time. As you progress the waves become more difficult. The map is split into four halls which contain 50 grandmasters. At the end of each hall is a Grandmaster’s Cache which are comparable to Izaro’s chests at the end of Uber Labyrinth.
The fact of reality is that 90% of builds cannot complete this map. For example, many of the grandmasters are running Chaos Innoculation so pure chaos damage builds are ineffective. Some grandmasters do too much damage or are too tanky (Aegis Aurora + Max Block) for the majority of characters to kill. Do not do this map on Hardcore (seriously it is probably harder than the Shaper). If in Softcore try this map out for fun and see how far you can get. There are many caveats for a lot of the grandmasters which can’t all be covered here. 
A few tips. Builds that use traps, mines or even Explosive Arrow can preload their abilities while the exiles are still immune. The super tank chracters with high regen/block can be partially countered with the block reduction support and frost bomb (to lower regen). Secondary damage can't be blocked so abilities like Scorching Ray are also extremely strong here. Watch out for some of the Necromancer exiles with buff zombies that leave poison clouds on death - these cloud will one shot you.

The monster level of this map can range from 70 to 79. Only five monsters are present in this map (Hey it’s not as bad as Death and Taxes). Heading south you come to a large room where you will find Kole from the Lunaris Temple, at this point he cannot take damage so just run on past him. The map splits off into four branches. At the end of each branch is a sub-boss that when killed buffs Kole in some way. Only once all the sub-bosses are down only then can you kill Kole. The sub bosses are the Vaal Oversoul, Hillock (from the Dunes map), the Weaver and Loathe – these guys aren’t too bad. When you return to the middle you find not one but TWO Koles. Luckily once you kill one the other dies. The Koles are hasted, have a heavy hitting ground smash and can grapple you from distance with their chains. Characters with good physical mitigation can simply tank them Squishy ranged characters will have to put in some effort trying to kite these two.
First form deals Fire Damage. Homing fire beams and GMP Incinerate. Second form does same skills but with Physical damage instead. Homing beams are significantly more dangerous in second form.

boss.description:
Monsters deal 175-190% extra damage as lightning. Bring Topaz flasks. A Purity of Lightning is also recommended for the additional maximum lightning resistance. Clearing the trash mobs doesn’t really matter; you can if you want but the loot isn’t anything special. At the end of the island you will find the ghost of Fairgraves. Interact with him and all the remaining monsters in the map will die.
Running over monster corpses will resurrect them as ghosts. While running over corpses you will encounter Booty chests. When opened, these chests give lots of currency items and after a few seconds Fairgraves himself will appear. Note at this stage Fairgraves can’t die so just run around for a while, dodging his Spectral Throw (which hits hard) – after 10-20 seconds he will disappear.
Keep running around the map until you have found and opened all 8 Booty chests (this can be tedious, note some corpses may be in the water). On the 8th chest (it pays to count) the final form of Fairgraves will appear surrounded by ghost pirates. Finally mortal, Fairgraves is more dangerous than before. Avoid his Spectral/Vaal Spectral Throw as well as his Summon Raging Spirits. Kill him to complete the map – hopefully you found some good currency along the way.

bossDescription:
[Tolman, the Exhumer](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Tolman,_the_Exhumer), based on the [Tolman](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Tolman) fight in [The Quay](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/The_Quay). The arena is fairly small, containing 4 bone piles with [Tolman, the Exhumer](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Tolman,_the_Exhumer) slightly off-center. Upon approaching the boss, a red Ankh appears and zombies begin to spawn from the bone piles. After a short time, Tolman becomes targetable and chases the player. During this phase, red [Desecrated Ground](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Desecrated_Ground) spawns, nearby corpses detonate, and red areas with a delayed detonation, similar to the ones cast by an [Undying Evangelist](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Undying_Evangelist), appear.

This boss does not count as spawned before engaging the boss, so [Eldritch Altars](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Eldritch_Altar) are unable to roll boss modifiers.

Tolman's only attack consists in a melee hit, which makes strategies relying on the [Divination Scarab of Pilfering](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Divination_Scarab_of_Pilfering) and [Strongboxes](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Strongbox) easy to perform on this map due to the ease of avoiding the boss.

boss.description:
In this map it pays to be fast. After nine minutes (6 if in a group) a 10 second countdown will be initiated. Any players remaining in the map after those 10 seconds are automatically killed. The map consists of 6 rooms. Each room contain a variety of monsters that must all be killed before moving through to the next room. The monster level of each subsequent room is increased by one.
After completing the 5th room Oba states you are a mighty adventurer. At this point the clock stops and the map will no longer become deadly. Venture into the 6th room to find a small area with 5 strongboxes; 2 rare Ornate strongboxes and a unique Jeweller’s, Gemcutter’s and Arcanist’s strongbox.

Similar to the Hallowed ground map except with mobs. You start in a large central room with four passages leading to boss rooms. Each passage contains mobs that deal a particular type of damage (Fire, Cold, Lightning and Chaos). The boss at the end of each passage is a unique totem that deals that type of damage. In particular, watch out for Izioc, the Abyss who can pump out serious Chaos damage with Ethereal Knives and Caustic Arrow if your Chaos resistance is low. Also, watch out for Achioc, the Glacier who can freeze your character easily with his Arctic Breath.
After killing all four sub-bosses you will face Olmec in the middle of the central room. Olmec uses a variety of abilities of different types – none of which are too threatening. The dangerous part of the fight is that Olmec resummons copies of the four unique totems you just killed. Together they can provide a headache. Note that even after killing these totems Olmec will resummon them after a time. Therefore, it is best to focus on killing Olmec. The room is large so you can head to the corners to avoid engaging all the bosses at once.

Mortar of Fire based projectiles that can shotgun the player. Summons skeletons and places offerings which deal Chaos or Fire DoT. Channels a laser beam that deals significant Fire DoT. Run behind a pillar to interrupt the beam. Green circle teleports players standing in it - potentially onto labynith traps on around the arena.

boss.description:
Hahahahahahahahahahahahahaha. Ahh, this map is pure chaos. 140-160% increased damage as well as the Fleet affix is not to be underestimated. The map is a large square based on the Lunaris Temple level 2. The mobs here are various Miscreations as well as Mortality Experimenters. For many characters this map is a case of get hit, you’re dead. Mobs move fast and hide around corners. Even experienced players may have a hard time navigating this map deathless.
Whipping Miscreations are quick, accurate and hit for a massive amount. They also inflict Vunerability so a second hit will likely spell death. Tentacle Miscreations destroy non-evasion based characters but are easily dodged.  Avoid standing on corpses as Mortality Expermienters use Detonate Dead – the increased life affix stacks with the increased damage affix on the map. My best advice is don’t rush through this map. 
In the top-left corner lies the boss, a unique Tentacle miscreation, that when compared to the rest of the mobs here doesn’t feel too threatening. She drops 10-15 rare items of a specific class. Although the real reward from this map is the amount of experience you can gain, as long as you don’t die…
Like a Russian doll; kill one boss, a smaller one spawns (4 times). Powerful Puncture and Blast Rain.

This map has two bosses.

Unique Bosses

[Blackguard Avenger](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Blackguard_Avenger), based on [Captain Arteri](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Captain_Arteri).

• Uses [Cleave](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Cleave)

• Uses [Double Strike](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Double_Strike)

[Blackguard Tempest](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Blackguard_Tempest), unique [Blackguard Mage](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Blackguard_Mage).

• Casts [Spark](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Spark)

• Casts [Lightning Thorns](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Lightning_Thorns)

• Creates small [Conductivity](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Conductivity) curse zones

Contrary to their unremarkable looks, the two bosses are capable of extremely high damage output. Lightning Thorns should always be approached with appropriate care. However the true danger poses the Blackguard Avengers Double Strike, which can even tear through tankier characters within mere moments. A potential stun-lock because of the powerful hits and resulting inability to act is a lethal threat. High defenses against physical damage are advised, otherwise the boss should absolutely be kited, which, luckily, is easy due to its lack of a gap-closing ability. One should also be aware that the duo is encountered at the very end of the map and because of their appearance it is easy to overlook them between other mobs, which can be a deadly mistake.

boss.description: Leap Slam. Charge attack. Powerful telegraphed "Cone Strike' deals Physical and Cold damage. After 90% life summons Mercury totems that summon piercing projectiles which explode for Cold damage after 3 seconds (only one totem active at a time). boss.description: Man have I underestimated this map before. You are inflicted with 5 unremovable curses; Vulnerability, Flammability, Frostbite, Conductivity and Projectile Weakness. Make sure your elemental resistances are adequately overcapped and you have Bleed removal before entering. Pieties miscreations occupy the zone - they are fast and can burst you down quickly. You face Act 5 Doedre 3 times. She isn't too difficult, just dodge her telegraphed projectiles. Watch out as throughout the fight various miscreations will continually spawn. Each boss will drop a lot of Divination cards (not zone dependent), similar to a Diviner's Strongbox. You may just hit big if you are lucky.

Large Temple, half owned by Solaris Fanatics (Fire damage) and half by Lunaris Fanatics (Cold damage). On each side are three floor buttons that when pressed summon Solaris/Lunaris mobs and the Sun/Moon Orb from Act 8. These orbs can use some of Solaris and Lunaris' more powerful abilities like the cascade of falling rocks. You will also see the unique mini-bosses from Act 8: Nightbringer Lucius, Regulus, Dawn and Dusk. At the end of the map you can choose to face either Lunaris or Solaris as the final boss. They both deal high amounts of hard to avoid damage but have little health.

Defeat the four mini-bosses (all have modest Lightning based abilities) located in each of the four corners. After they are all dead you will be able to face the Avatar of Thunder in his arena at the centre of the map. There are four boss phases and three add phases. During the boss phases, the Avatar will use a Physical Cyclone and a Physical/Lightning Earthquake. The Avatar will also charge up and then explode for massive Lightning AoE damage that always Shocks (but will most likely one-shot) - get out of the way when this happens. Three beams of light will also travel around the arena - these beams deal Lightning DoT and always Shock. In each of the add phases the Avatar will teleport out and summon one of his four guardians defeated previously. Each subsuquent add phase has an extra mini boss you have to kill (so one, then two, then three). Overall a long fight, but a large arena, so plenty of room to kite and avoid the dangerous boss abilities.

layoutDescription:
This map contains a lobby, a theatre, and a larger backstage area composed of multiple interconnected rooms.

bossDescription:

Skills:

• Basic projectile

• "Engulf!" - Meteor Rain - Creates several orb projectiles in the air that fall after a delay, then travel in random directions.

• "Unveiling hope!"/"Coursing faith!" - Eye of Summer - Fires a large orb that fires several orb projectiles in random directions as it travels.

• Multiblast - Creates three large circles on the ground that explode after a duration.

• "Belief and conviction shall free your mind... Open your heart!"/"Beyond what you see, there is more... Give yourself to faith!" - Fire Maze - Creates multiple rings of fire with gaps.

• "Believe... in me!" - Divine Beam - Charges forward before channelling a large beam, waving it back and forth, dealing fire damage over time and increasing fire damage taken by 10%. Creates large lightning orbs in two rows along the sides of the arena.

It is a large single-floor area with various-sized rooms and hallways as well as elevation changes. Vaal Temple contains 10 [strongbox](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Strongbox) versions of [Vaal Vessels](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Vaal_Vessel), with each spawning 3 packs of monsters as well as a [Vaal side area](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Vaal_side_area) Boss. These Vaal Vessels have additional drops themed around corruption, including [Vaal skill](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Vaal_skill) gems, corrupted [jewels](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Jewel), [double corrupted](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Double_corrupt) [Uniques](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Unique), corrupted [maps](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Map) and [Vaal Orb](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Vaal_Orb)Vaal OrbStack Size: 20Corrupts an item, modifying it unpredictablyRight click this item then left click an item to corrupt it. Corrupted items cannot be modified again.s. These are affected by Atlas passive skills that affect strongboxes.

However, there are currently no known ways to affect the number of Vaal Vessels generated:

As the Vaal Vessel modifier on the map basetype is an implicit modifier, it is retained when the map is randomly rerolled using the [Twist of Fate](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Twist_of_Fate) [Atlas keystone](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Atlas_keystone)[[1]](#cite_note-1). boss.description: A map with no monsters whatsoever (although Tormented Spirits and Rogue Exiles can still spawn for some reason – who knows how they got into Atziri’s vault?). This map contains only chests with 1800-2000% increased item rarity. Simply walk around the two large rooms and loot every chest. At the centre of the second room is a chest that contains large amounts of Sacrifice Fragments and Vaal skill gems.
Stay out of Chilling Totem beams and off Shocking Ground. When channelling his Lightning beam run in a circle around the boss. Avoid 'Touch of God' slam - it will most likely one shot you.

Third is the group of hallways, which ends with a balcony overlooking the garden and a portal that leads to the boss arena.

boss.description: Doedre has two attacks: firstly firing three Physical projectiles, secondly a teleported warp dealing a large amount of Physical damage. While the room is red, small red balls spawn, exploding for minor Physical damage but inflicting a stacking debuff (up to 10) which causes you to take increased damage. While the room is green, zombies will continuously spawn - when slain these zombies inflict a stacking debuff causing you to deal less damage. While the room is purple, small purple areas spawn which deal Chaos DoT and slow your character. At any point during the fight you can pull the valve to removes all debuffs and ground effects - changing the room to the next colour but also giving Doedre a buff (depending on the colour). The room always starts red, then green, the purple.

boss.description:
You arrive on a misty island similar to the Ship Graveyard and start with reduced light radius. Killing monsters increases your light radius and also your IIR and IIQ. Not killing monsters causes you light radius to fall. Once you have cleared the island make your way to the cave at the top of the island.
Inside the cave activate the Vaal seal. A Shade of an Exile will spawn depending on your class. This exile can be fast and dangerous so take caution in avoiding their attacks. After you have killed the exile you face the true boss of this map, the most annoying boss in all Path of Exile. I don’t really want to ruin the surprise so play and find out.
Weak lightning spells, and summons 6 Flood Orbs with Cyclone skill. Boss is tanky with the purple shield as it gives 50% reduced damage taken.

bossDescription: [Stone of the Currents](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Stone_of_the_Currents)

Nightmare of Catarina - This boss is an uber version of [Catarina, Master of Undeath](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Catarina,_Master_of_Undeath). At every 25% life lost, she will summon minibosses based on [Kurgal](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Kurgal), [Ulaman](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Ulaman), and [Amanamu](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Amanamu). Catarina will be invincible until the Abyssal Lich boss is defeated.

• Carpet Mortar - Darkness swarms! - Spell which fires a barrage of soul projectiles in front of her

• X Circle - Mortal! - Drops a scythe from the sky which then expands in X shape

• Circle X - Feel death's grip! - Large skull appears with X-shaped bite effect

• Volatile Object Explode - Arise, my children. Feed! - Spawns many skull on the ground that will turn into crawling skeletons if not destroyed by walking into them within 10 seconds. Crawling skeletons will explode on contact.

• Sideways Carpet Bomb - Spell which spawns multiple small green bombs on the floor, which will then detonate in sequence

• Scythe swing - Your soul burns for me!- Scythe attack with long range. Can't be [Evaded](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Evasion)

• Rollout - Give your soul to me! - Teleports to the player and charges an [area of effect](https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Area_of_effect) attack that increases in AoE if the player moves away. Wait for the particle effect to fully dissipiate before dodging.

• Unearth Slam - Kulemak! - Throws her staff into the ground which leaves a damaging area effect pool (?)

• Soul Mortar - Barrage of soul projectiles without a voiceline

• Teleport - Catarina repositions herself

After Kurgal is summoned, he will create a pattern of green beams around the edge of the arena, which inflicts the "Lich's Beam" debuff that deal physical damage over time. This will persist for the remainder of the fight.
